sentences.text: The available policy materials do not state a late payment fee amount for credit card dues.

The only directly related in-force text says that charges recovered from borrowers on behalf of third-party service providers can form part of APR, and it expressly says credit card receivables are exempted from the paragraph that contains that rule.

The other in-force policy text only says that the policy shall clearly lay down the liability by way of interest payments due to delays for non-compliance with the bank’s own standards, without giving a fee amount for credit card dues.
The searched rules on penal charges and late-payment-related charges do not provide a credit-card late payment fee amount in the evidence provided.
